If sqld refuses the statement, the card goes back to him and this head may change; I will send a delta then. Reviewing now saves the queue time.
- Points to read: the comma refusal (libSQL's splice ends the old definition at the first comma, so such a column is refused whole and left byte-identical); the in-batch check plus rollback on a face with no transactions (ADR-0119 D1); the advisory `object-column-changes-not-applied` still covered by a refused relax.
